About us

SunnyDayz is an independently owned, vertically integrated craft cannabis company built around a simple belief: how cannabis is grown, made, and sold matters.

We cultivate in organic soil, hand water, hand trim, and select genetics for rich terpene profiles, flavor, and overall quality—not THC% alone. That same philosophy extends to our dispensary, where every product is carefully curated and selected, with a focus on craft brands that share our standards and ethos.

Our deli-style Bud Bar brings transparency back to buying cannabis, giving customers the opportunity to see, smell, learn about, and choose their flower with confidence.

At SunnyDayz, we’re doing things differently. 

Small Batch, Real farmers. Real flavor.
